Not theory."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## The problem"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Recurring-content accounts (morning greetings, goodnight wishes, solar-term cards, homilies, blessin"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"g cards…) rarely fail because they “write badly”. They fail because the platform flags them as **low"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" creativity** and turns off public recommendation. The platform scores a combination of signals — ca"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"tegory × format × frequency × fixed phrases:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- The same greeting text on every image, the same title prefix, the same hashtags, day after day;
- "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"Multiple near-duplicate posts per day cannibalizing each other;
- Templated structure: five posts wi"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"th the same skeleton = low-creativity signal."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"This plugin provides an executable **anti-homogenization production pipeline**: structure-signature "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"rotation, the “daily delta” test, a visual baseline for blessing images, OCR acceptance for on-image"},{"id":"p9s3","text":" text, interaction rules, and draft-box sync — including measured parameters for the xiaolvshu (news"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"pic) internal web API."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## What's inside"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Capability | Details |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Rotation writing method | Six-variable structure signatures, anti-recency selection, six anti-homo"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"genization self-checks, anti-AI-slop language rules |
| Daily delta test | Delete test / replace tes"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"t, seven rotating “conversation starter” sources |
| Low-creativity remediation | Root-cause analysi"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"s, remediation direction, recovery cadence, filter rules for common advice (de-identified) |
| Visua"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"l baseline | Quantified “festive at a glance, clear on second look, credible on third” standard + 8 "},{"id":"p12s6","text":"acceptance checks |
| Image pipeline | Native 2.35:1 cover prompt template, anti-typo rules for on-i"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"mage Chinese text, OCR acceptance SOP, troubleshooting |
| Interaction guide | One primary call-to-a"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"ction (+ at most one secondary), fixed comment prompts, red lines, closing three-part formula |
| Pu"},{"id":"p12s9","text":"blishing | Measured xiaolvshu (newspic) draft web API: upload `scene=5`, full `operate_appmsg type=7"},{"id":"p12s10","text":"7` form + format switches |
| Scripts | `generate_images.py` (templated image generation), `ocr_veri"},{"id":"p12s11","text":"fy.py` (macOS Vision / MiniMax M3 dual backends) |
| Log templates | Structure log and image log tem"},{"id":"p12s12","text":"plates (the rotation ledger) |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"After install, the model loads the `wechat-mp-studio` skill on demand (when writing MP content, gene"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"rating images, syncing drafts, or debugging low-creativity flags). You can also invoke it explicitly"},{"id":"p15s3","text":": “use wechat-mp-studio to draft today's post”."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"1. **Write**: tell the model your account positioning (audience / persona / monetization) and let th"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"e pipeline produce copy + a structure signature.
2. **Generate images**: `python3 skills/wechat-mp-s"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"tudio/scripts/generate_images.py cover --text "<today's blessing>" --anchor "<subject>"` (set `IMAGE"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"_API_KEY` to a gpt-image-compatible endpoint).
3. **Verify**: `python3 skills/wechat-mp-studio/scrip"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"ts/ocr_verify.py --image cover.png --expected "<today's blessing>"`.
4. **Sync draft**: follow `refe"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"rences/xiaolvshu-web-api.md` to push to the draft box (drafts only — publishing stays human-confirme"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"d).
5. **Log**: append one row each to the structure log and image log; the next post reads them for"},{"id":"p17s8","text":" anti-recency selection."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Layout"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Disclaimer"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- The WeChat MP web APIs (`operate_appmsg`, etc.) are internal, undocumented, and subject to change "},{"id":"p21s2","text":"at any time.
